=== .dx/bazelrc/correctness.bazelrc
# Vendored Bazel execution preset -- GENERATED, do not edit.
# Regenerate: `tools/dx init --apply`.
# Layer correctness: flags that change what a build or test produces.

# Print the full command line of a failed action.
build --verbose_failures

# Show the log of a failing test in the console.
test --test_output=errors

# Apply the linux, macos and windows config lines on matching hosts.
common --enable_platform_specific_config

# Make LLVM coverage write lcov data.
coverage --test_env=GENERATE_LLVM_LCOV=1

# Merge the coverage of every test into one lcov report.
coverage --combined_report=lcov

# Skip tests tagged no-coverage during coverage runs.
coverage --test_tag_filters=-no-coverage

# Coverage collectors read their inputs from a runfiles tree.
coverage --enable_runfiles

# Instrument only targets in the main repository.
coverage --instrumentation_filter=^//

# Instrument test targets so sources a test compiles itself are counted.
coverage --instrument_test_targets

# On Windows, build runfiles trees only for actions that run.
build:windows --nobuild_runfile_links

# On Windows, give tests a runfiles directory instead of only a manifest.
build:windows --enable_runfiles

# On Windows, rustc links with rust-lld; clang-cl cannot drive a Rust link.
build:windows --@rules_dx//config:toolchain_linker_preference=rust

# On Windows, build host tools on the MSVC-ABI host so rustc and clang-cl agree on the ABI.
common:windows --host_platform=@rules_dx//tools/platforms:windows_msvc_host

# On Windows, prefer the MSVC-ABI host for actions and keep the plain host as a fallback.
common:windows --extra_execution_platforms=@rules_dx//tools/platforms:windows_msvc_host,@platforms//host

# Run Java targets on the downloaded JDK 21, not a host JDK.
build --java_runtime_version=remotejdk_21

# Run Java build tools on the downloaded JDK 21.
build --tool_java_runtime_version=remotejdk_21

# Compile Java build tools at language level 17.
build --tool_java_language_version=17

# Opt out of aspect_tools_telemetry usage reports.
common --repo_env=DO_NOT_TRACK=1

# Clippy findings are part of the build output, as in dx build.
build --@rules_dx//config:clippy_output_diagnostics=true

# Rustc diagnostics are part of the build output, as in dx build.
build --@rules_dx//config:rustc_output_diagnostics=true

# Under --config=ci, fail when MODULE.bazel.lock is out of date.
common:ci --lockfile_mode=error

# Under --config=ci, skip probing the host JDK for @local_jdk.
common:ci --repo_env=JAVA_HOME=dx-no-local-jdk

# Under --config=ci, build runfiles trees only for actions that run.
common:ci --nobuild_runfile_links

# Compiler warnings fail the build under the strict profile.
common --@rules_dx//config:warnings_as_errors=false
common --@rules_dx//config:config_profile=standard

# The workspace policy dx generates from dx.toml.
common --@rules_dx//config:workspace=//.dx:policy
=== .dx/bazelrc/performance.bazelrc
# Vendored Bazel execution preset -- GENERATED, do not edit.
# Regenerate: `tools/dx init --apply`.
# Layer performance: build speed and the dx compilation configs.

# Build host tools without optimization so builds finish sooner.
build --host_compilation_mode=fastbuild

# The dx_build_debug config builds with debug symbols.
build:dx_build_debug --compilation_mode=dbg

# The dx_build_dev config builds unoptimized for quick edit and test loops.
build:dx_build_dev --compilation_mode=fastbuild

# The dx_build_release config builds optimized target code.
build:dx_build_release --compilation_mode=opt

# The dx_build_release config also optimizes host tools.
build:dx_build_release --host_compilation_mode=opt

# The dx_dev_remote config builds unoptimized on remote executors.
build:dx_dev_remote --compilation_mode=fastbuild

# The dx_toolchain config builds toolchains unoptimized.
build:dx_toolchain --compilation_mode=fastbuild

# Under --config=ci, run 64 actions at once, since remote cache hits hold job slots.
common:ci --jobs=64

# Under --config=ci, compress remote cache transfers.
common:ci --remote_cache_compression

# Under --config=ci, send blobs under 100 bytes uncompressed.
common:ci --experimental_remote_cache_compression_threshold=100

# Under --config=ci, allow a remote cache call 10 minutes.
common:ci --remote_timeout=10m

# Under --config=ci, build locally when the remote cache fails.
common:ci --remote_local_fallback

# Under --config=ci, retry a failed remote cache call 5 times.
common:ci --remote_retries=5

# Under --config=ci, rebuild 5 times when the remote cache evicts an input.
common:ci --experimental_remote_cache_eviction_retries=5

# Under --config=ci, look up 32 repositories at once, since each remote contents cache lookup waits on the network.
common:ci --loading_phase_threads=32

# Under --config=ci-pr, read the remote cache without writing to it.
common:ci-pr --noremote_upload_local_results
=== .dx/bazelrc/resources.bazelrc
# Vendored Bazel execution preset -- GENERATED, do not edit.
# Regenerate: `tools/dx init --apply`.
# Layer resources: memory, CPU and cache limits for the host.

# Let the Bazel server return unused heap to the system sooner.
startup --host_jvm_args=-XX:MaxHeapFreeRatio=30

# Keep little spare heap after a garbage collection.
startup --host_jvm_args=-XX:MinHeapFreeRatio=10

# Cap the Bazel server heap at a quarter of host memory.
startup --host_jvm_args=-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=25

# Schedule local actions within half of host memory.
common --local_resources=memory=HOST_RAM*.5

# Leave a quarter of the CPUs for the rest of the machine.
common --local_resources=cpu=HOST_CPUS*.75

# Stop a Bazel server after 15 idle minutes.
startup --max_idle_secs=900

# Stop an idle Bazel server when the host runs low on memory.
startup --shutdown_on_low_sys_mem

# Drop disk cache entries unused for 14 days.
common --experimental_disk_cache_gc_max_age=14d

# Keep the disk cache under 20 GB.
common --experimental_disk_cache_gc_max_size=20G

# Drop repository contents cache entries unused for 60 days.
common --repo_contents_cache_gc_max_age=60d

# Shrink persistent worker pools when memory runs low.
build --experimental_shrink_worker_pool

# Cap the memory of all persistent workers together at 4 GB.
build --experimental_total_worker_memory_limit_mb=4096

# Under --config=ci, schedule local actions on every CPU.
common:ci --local_resources=cpu=HOST_CPUS
